reviews.title: Worst service
reviews.text:
Three days ago, I experienced a very serious issue with an inDrive courier rider. I had already paid NPR 370 online for the delivery service. However, even after completing the delivery, the rider also collected an additional NPR 250 in cash from my brother.

I immediately reported this issue to inDrive Support and also sent a complaint via email. Unfortunately, I have not received any proper response or solution so far.

Today, instead of addressing my complaint, I received a message asking me to rate my experience with inDrive’s service. This is extremely disappointing and frustrating. We contacted your support team because we expected our problem to be resolved, not because we wanted to receive a request to rate your service.

Honestly, this experience has completely destroyed my trust in inDrive. From now on, I will never use this app again, and I would not recommend it to anyone.

Compared to Pathao and Yango, inDrive’s customer support is very disappointing. When customers face problems with Pathao or Yango, they can contact customer support directly by phone and get assistance. Unfortunately, inDrive does not seem to provide the same level of accessible customer support.

I strongly urge inDrive to take customer complaints seriously, investigate this incident, and refund the extra NPR 250 collected by the rider.

A company should not ask customers to rate its service while their complaints remain unresolved. Customer satisfaction begins with solving customer problems.

reviews.title: EXPLOIT BOTH RIDER AND DRIVER
reviews.text:
inDrive is a useful transport app, but it is disappointing when both drivers and passengers feel that the system is working against them.

Passengers are expected to pay for transport, while drivers must cover fuel, vehicle maintenance, and other operating expenses. Yet the way fares and platform fees are handled can leave drivers struggling to make a reasonable income while passengers still feel they are paying too much.

When the company benefits while drivers and passengers feel disadvantaged, it creates unnecessary tension between the two sides. This can lead to disagreements, poor service, and situations that may put people’s safety at risk.

inDrive must remember that drivers and passengers are the foundation of its business. Drivers deserve fair compensation for their time, fuel, and effort. Passengers deserve reasonable prices, respectful service, and safe journeys.

A transport platform should connect people fairly, not leave both sides feeling exploited. Be transparent about service fees, ensure drivers can earn a fair income, and help passengers access affordable transport.

At the end of the day, a business cannot thrive sustainably if the people who keep it running feel neglected. Put people before profit and create a system that benefits drivers, passengers, and the company alike.

reviews.title: عدم الرد بخصوص استلام الجائزة
reviews.text:
اتصل بي شخص من فريق الدعم وأخبرني أنني فزت بهاتف. وللتأكد من أن الاتصال رسمي وليس من شخص عادي، تواصلت مع الدعم من خلال التطبيق، وتأكدت أن الرقم الذي اتصل بي تابع لهم بالفعل.

الشخص الذي اتصل بي أكد لي أنني فزت بالهاتف، لكن عندما حاولت التواصل معه لمعرفة الطريقة المتاحة لاستلام الجائزة، بدأ يتجاهل رسائلي ولم يعد يجيبني.

كما أنني تواصلت مع الدعم عبر التطبيق، لكنني لم أتلقَّ أي مساعدة فعلية، وإنما فقط ردود منسوخة دون الاهتمام بمشكلتي أو توضيح وضع الجائزة.

أريد فقط معرفة وضع جائزتي وكيف يمكنني استلامها، وأرجو التعامل مع الموضوع بجدية وتزويدي بإجابة واضحة.

reviews.title: Driver since the app launched in Morocco
reviews.text:
As a driver, I’m very disappointed with inDrive. The platform seems to care much more about passengers than drivers. If a passenger refuses to pay, behaves badly, or leaves an unfair negative review just because the driver refuses to take them somewhere different from the destination they entered in the app, the driver has very little protection or support.

Since I started using the app, fares have continuously decreased while fuel and other expenses keep increasing. Drivers are expected to accept lower and lower prices while taking all the risks and costs themselves.

inDrive needs to start listening to its drivers and treating them fairly. Without drivers, there is no service. Very disappointing experience.

reviews.title: Derivers Overcharged Customers and Support Refuses to refund
reviews.text:
⭐ 1 Star

Very disappointing customer service. I was charged an extra Rs 40 by a driver who claimed he had no change, even though I specifically asked him before the ride and he confirmed that he had change.

This is not the first time. I previously reported another driver for charging me an extra Rs 50, and despite contacting inDrive, I still have not received my refund or a proper resolution.

What is even more frustrating is that support keeps telling me that disciplinary action has been taken against the drivers but refuses to refund the money that was improperly collected from me.

If inDrive cannot protect customers from drivers charging extra and cannot refund customers when this happens, then I have no reason to trust the service.

Very poor handling of customer complaints. I expected better from inDrive.

The app feels unreliable, and passengers are left without meaningful support when problems arise. inDrive needs to hold drivers accountable and improve how it handles customer complaints.

reviews.title: Used to be great with VoiceOver, now it’s unusable
reviews.text:
I’ve been using inDrive for years and it used to work wonderfully with VoiceOver. Over the last two years or so, the accessibility has gotten worse and worse.

I tried to book a ride this week and it’s now impossible to accept a ride after booking, or even to hear and compare different offers from drivers. VoiceOver does not read key buttons and sections properly, so I can’t navigate the booking flow independently.

This is really disappointing because inDrive was one of the more accessible ride apps.

*Request to developers*: Please urgently make the app fully compliant with VoiceOver again. People who are blind or have low vision rely on VoiceOver to book rides safely and independently. Right now the app blocks us from using a basic service.

I hope this gets fixed soon so everyone can use inDrive freely and without difficulty.

Rating: 1 star until accessibility is fixed.

reviews.title: Unfair policy — drivers are being robbed!
reviews.text: This app's cancellation policy is completely one-sided and unfair to drivers. If I cancel a trip for any reason, I get charged 28 LE immediately. But when I drive all the way to the pickup point and the rider cancels at the last second, I get NOTHING — no compensation for my time, fuel, or effort. I wasted my fuel and wear on my car for absolutely nothing. The service fee is still deducted from my balance and takes up to 30 days to refund IF I'm lucky enough to get it back at all. This policy is exploiting drivers who are just trying to make a living. Fix this unfair system!

reviews.title: WARNING: Driver Stole My Money and Product. inDrive Deleted My Account After I Reported It
reviews.text:
This app promotes drivers who steal from their clients.

I requested a courier delivery to my home, and the trip was R60. Upon arrival, I paid the driver R100, but he said he did not have change. I suggested fetching R10 so he could give me R50 back.

While I was doing this, he sped off with both my money and my product.

I escalated the matter and reported it to support, but all I received were apologies with no clear way forward regarding reporting the driver or refunding my money. After two days of consistent follow-ups, I woke up to find that my account had been deleted.

It seems inDrive is more interested in protecting profits than protecting clients, even when clients are being robbed through their platform.

I hope more people see this review and share their own experiences. inDrive management needs to take accountability and address this properly.

reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text:
At first, inDrive was an excellent app, and I have been using it since the very beginning. Unfortunately, the experience in Lebanon has become very disappointing, as the app now feels driver-oriented rather than passenger-friendly.
Drivers can mark themselves as “arrived” even when they are still 20 minutes away, and the app often fails to track their real location. Passengers end up receiving 1-star reviews for “not showing up on time,” even though the driver has not actually arrived.
There are also major location issues in Lebanon. Sometimes my request doesn’t appear to nearby drivers at all; instead, it is shown only to drivers who are at least 15 minutes away, despite the fact that many closer drivers are available, as confirmed by friends who work with inDrive.
Another concern is that many drivers operate under their own companies rather than independently through inDrive. They wait for signals from their company to accept rides, which affects the reliability of the service.
Lastly, I truly enjoyed using inDrive more than any other transport app, but it is disappointing that deleting it became my only option. Unfortunately, this experience justifies the rating I gave.
Thank you in advance.

This is falsely advertised as “you pick the price” or “negotiate” but the truth is that firstly it’s never you who picks the price, it’s always the driver that has final say - you either accept or decline only just for another driver to offer u another expensive rate which is often higher than the recommended rate. 
I wish it had a feature where u could actively negotiate with the driver!
Secondly the rates are already quite high especially compared to Yango who give much cheaper rates and their cars are also much more clean and fit for purpose, which leads me only my final point
The standard of cars on this app is actually quite bad especially compared to Yango who always have good clean rides. 
I wouldn’t advise anyone to download this and instead use Yango because it does everything better and cheaper!

Furthermore they don’t have 24/7 customer support like they claim. Been trying to get assistance from them for the past 3 days to no avail.
